Team W Divers Pro's

Meet the people you'll dive with.

Shipwrecks, dugongs, hot springs and magnificent caves: an invitation to dive into the waters of Coron. Meet the instructors of Team W Divers.

Team W Divers

Dean Kang

Head Instructor

Dean leads W Divers Coron and trains both divers and instructors, with instructor ratings across five agencies.

Instructor ratings

  • SSI Instructor Trainer #112373
  • PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer (MSDT) #370544
  • SDI Instructor #25307
  • TDI Instructor #25307
  • IDEA Instructor #K00419

Specialty instructor

  • Deep
  • Enriched Air
  • Sidemount
  • Equipment Specialist
  • Project AWARE
  • Peak Performance Buoyancy
  • Wreck
  • AWARE Coral Reef Conservation
  • EFR / Care for Children with AED
  • Snorkel

Inhan Kang

Rookie Instructor

Teaches in native-level English, Tagalog and Korean

Inhan qualified as a PADI Instructor at 18 and teaches recreational, technical and wreck courses.

Instructor ratings

  • PADI Instructor
  • SDI Instructor
  • TDI Technical Instructor
  • TDI Advanced Wreck Diver Instructor

Jex Lenver Tabat (GIGs)

Divemaster

A Filipino divemaster on the W Divers team, guiding divers on the boat and underwater.

Certification

  • SSI Divemaster

On screen in Coron.

The W Divers team has supported Korean film and TV productions shooting in Coron.

Dive with Team W Divers.

Send your dates, group size and diving experience, and the team will help plan your time in Coron.
